data.action: 赤足坐在白色病床边，双手静静捧着眼镜
data.description: 【绫波丽 · 晨曦病房与苍白绷带】极简冷清的单人病房内，素白的窗帘被晨风轻轻掀起。身着宽松病服、缠绕着层层医疗绷带的绫波丽赤足坐在床沿，手中静静捧着那副属于碇司令的破损眼镜，眼神空灵而带着一丝难以捉摸的依恋——「疼痛……只是肉体存在的证明。但我心中的那份羁绊，又究竟属于谁呢？」
data.lighting: 清晨冷白晨光与柔和微光
data.promptProse: Rei sits barefoot on the single hospital bed's edge in a loose white patient gown, left-arm and chest bandages visible beneath her medical eyepatch. She quietly holds the Commander's damaged glasses. The eye-level medium view includes the pale curtain moving beside the window and sparse room surfaces behind. Cold-white morning light illuminates the glasses and her fingers, softening into gentle shadows beneath the gown and mattress edge.
data.title: 绫波丽 · 晨曦病房与苍白绷带
